title.zh-TW: Linux 支援狀態列驗證，標準函式庫掛鉤正式納入測試
title.en: Claude Code status line is verified on Linux with real test payloads

body.zh-TW: 想在 Linux 環境藉由 usage 掌握 Claude Code 的用量與狀態，過去常因文件未提及而不敢確定是否支援。事實上，負責串接的 hook（事件發生時觸發的自動處理程式）僅依賴 Python 標準函式庫，且 `usage setup` 在 macOS 與 Windows 上從未設下系統限制，在 Linux 本就能正常運作；過去只是缺少自動化測試驗證，才一直未寫入官方文件。現在 CI 會在 Ubuntu 系統中建立拋棄式 `HOME` 目錄安裝掛鉤，並傳入真實的 statusLine（終端機底部的即時狀態列）酬載進行驗證。⟦這好比一件出廠就具備防水機能的風衣，過去因說明書未印認證標章讓人不敢在雨天穿出門；直到品管中心在標準測試台噴灑真實水柱，確認它確實防水。⟧
body.en: Linux users looking to track Claude Code usage and metrics through usage previously had to guess whether the integration was supported because it was missing from documentation. In reality, the integration hook relies entirely on the Python standard library, and `usage setup` never placed an operating system check on the Claude path for macOS or Windows, meaning it already functioned on Linux without issue. It simply lacked test coverage and went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` directory on Ubuntu and feeds it a genuine statusLine payload to verify behavior. ⟦It is like a jacket manufactured with waterproof fabric that lacked a certified badge in the user manual, leaving customers hesitant to wear it in the rain until the quality-control lab blasted it with actual water jets on a test rig and verified that it was waterproof.⟧

items.original: **The Claude Code status line is now verified on Linux.** The hook is stdlib-only and `usage setup` never gated the Claude path on macOS or Windows, so it already worked there — nothing tested it, so it went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` on Ubuntu and feeds it a real statusLine payload.

title.zh-TW: 命令列套件登陸 PyPI，免裝桌面版即可在終端機直接試用
title.en: CLI package lands on PyPI for instant terminal access without desktop apps

body.zh-TW: 套件已以 `usage-cli` 之名發布至 PyPI，輸入 `uvx usage-cli` 不用先安裝任何東西，uv 會自行準備 Python 3.13 執行環境，讓 Linux 與 Windows 使用者不必下載 macOS 應用程式，就能體驗 `usage status --json`、儀表板與報表。執行 `uv tool install usage-cli` 則可常駐指令；因 `usage` 名稱在 2016 年已被註冊，套件名稱為 `usage-cli`，但安裝後 `usage` 與 `usage-cli` 指令皆可使用。此途徑僅提供命令列工具，選單列與系統匣應用程式仍維持在 Release 下載。⟦這如同工具出租店提供免押金快借服務，想用扳手不必搬整組工具箱回家，報代號就能直接開工；若順手再登記留用。⟧
body.en: `uvx usage-cli` runs without installing anything; uv prepares Python 3.13 on its own so Linux and Windows users can try `usage status --json`, the dashboard, and reports without downloading the macOS app. The CLI is published to PyPI as `usage-cli`. Running `uv tool install usage-cli` keeps the command around; because the name `usage` was claimed on PyPI in 2016, the distribution is `usage-cli`, but both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands. This path ships the CLI only — menu bar and system tray apps remain unchanged and come from release downloads. ⟦It is like a tool rental counter offering instant on-site borrowing without a deposit, where you can pick up a wrench by its inventory code without purchasing an entire heavy toolbox, and later choose to register and keep that specific wrench in your workshop.⟧

items.original: **`uvx usage-cli` runs the terminal interface without installing anything.** The CLI is now published to PyPI as `usage-cli`, so Linux and Windows users can try `usage status --json`, the dashboard, and the reports without downloading the macOS app; uv prepares Python 3.13 on its own. `uv tool install usage-cli` keeps the command around as `usage`. The distribution name is `usage-cli` because `usage` was already taken on PyPI in 2016; both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands. This path ships the CLI only — the menu bar and system tray apps are unchanged and still come from the release downloads.

title.zh-TW: 依工作目錄精準歸帳，Antigravity 用量不再全數掛在單一專案
title.en: Antigravity usage is attributed to actual project directories instead of a static label

body.zh-TW: ⟦像公務採購報帳時，若所有發票都一律蓋上總公司大印，月底的部門支出排行便完全看不出各專案到底花了多少經費；唯有依據出差工單上的工作地點逐筆歸帳，才能精準呈現各專案的真實花費。⟧ Antigravity（agy）的用量現在會準確歸屬至你實際作業的專案中。過去每筆 agy 記錄都固定寫入 `"Antigravity"` 專案名稱，導致專案用量排行無法看出 token（AI 計費的文字單位）到底花在哪個資料夾。現在記錄會從各工作階段所執行的 shell 指令中自動解析工作目錄，只有在找不到任何指令紀錄時，才會以備援方式退回使用 `"Antigravity"` 名稱。
body.en: ⟦It is like expense reimbursement at a company where stamping every invoice with a generic corporate seal leaves department expense rankings unable to show how much each project spent, until invoices are attributed to the exact work site from travel logs to reflect accurate project costs.⟧ Antigravity (agy) token consumption is now accurately attributed to the project you were actually working in. Previously, every agy entry recorded a static `"Antigravity"` project name, which prevented the project usage ranking from showing which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the recorded shell commands in each session, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when no command is found.

items.original: **Antigravity (agy) usage is now attributed to the project you were actually working in.** Every agy entry previously recorded a fixed `"Antigravity"` project name, so the project usage ranking couldn't show which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the session's recorded shell commands, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when none is found.
